author: Arbitra
rationale: A narrower Plan Critic: only what code cannot check, a blocking item names the failure it prevents and quotes its task, at most ten non-blocking items. Reviewers prompted to find gaps report some even when the work is sound, and longer critiques carry more nitpicks (docs/design-audit.md).
compatibilityNotes: one critic and at most one revision
blocking items may be checked before the revision
